Home Minister A. Namassivayam called on Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports Mansukh Mandaviya in New Delhi. | Photo Credit: SPECIAL ARRANGEMENT
Puducherry Minister for Home and BJP leader A. Namassivayam on Friday met Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports Mansukh Mandaviya in New Delhi. He is also the Minister for Labour and Employment.
Besides being a Minister in the Prime Minister Narendra Modi-led National Democratic Alliance government at the Centre, Mr. Mandaviya was BJP’s in-charge for the April 2026 Assembly elections in the Union Territory. Mr. Namassivayam’s Office said Friday’s meeting with Mr. Mandaviya was purely to discuss official matters pertaining to the administration of Puducherry.
The Home Minister took up the Union Territory’s demand for establishing a National Centre of Excellence for sporting events, such as athletics, kabaddi, hockey, volleyball and weightlifting in Puducherry. He also briefed him about the development of sports infrastructure including synthetic athletic track and astro turf hockey field at the Indira Gandhi Sports Complex.
He sought funds to the tune of ₹25 crore to distribute cash awards to meritorious sports persons pertaining to the period from 2004 to 2024.
Later in the day, Mr. Namassivayam met party national general secretary (organisation) B. L. Santosh. The Minister said he discussed the current political situation in Puducherry with Mr. Santosh.
